Yes. The main concern is Supplier A’s payment due 26 Oct: the original forecast shows a BDT 19,000 shortfall. Trimming the order reduces the amount due from BDT 60,000 to BDT 49,200, leaving BDT 8,200 to cover.

I proposed trimming the order, asking Supplier A for 20 more days, and a mobile-wallet loan as a fallback. These are waiting for your approval in Actions. The loan fallback costs BDT 181.97.

Also, BDT 9,200 of returns may still be claimed, but the supplier credit may arrive too late to cover this payment. BDT 18,400 of stock expires within 60 days, and BDT 10,000 of patient dues is over 30 days old.
